# Engaging the EA Team

**← Back to [Foundation](./README.md) • [EAP Home](../README.md)**

---

> This document provides guidance on how stakeholders across Gainwell can effectively engage with the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team, outlining available services, engagement models, request processes, and best practices for successful collaboration.

---
page_texts.3:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#11-our-mission]

### 1.1 Our Mission

The purpose of the Enterprise Architecture team is to enable Gainwell's technology landscape to deliver maximum business value through strategic guidance, architectural excellence, and collaborative partnership with all stakeholders.
page_texts.4:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#12-who-we-support]

### 1.2 Who We Support

The EA team provides services to all Gainwell stakeholders, including:

- **Product Teams**: Solution design, technology decisions, integration patterns
- **Development Teams**: Architecture guidance, design reviews, best practices
- **Project Managers**: Architectural feasibility, risk assessment, resource planning
- **Business Stakeholders**: Technology strategy, capability roadmaps, investment guidance
- **Operations Teams**: System architecture, scalability planning, performance optimization
- **Security Teams**: Security architecture, compliance alignment, threat modeling
- **Leadership**: Technology vision, strategic initiatives, architectural governance
page_texts.5:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#13-value-we-deliver]

### 1.3 Value We Deliver

Engaging with the EA team provides:

- **Risk Reduction**: Early identification and mitigation of architectural risks
- **Cost Optimization**: Guidance on efficient technology investments and avoiding technical debt
- **Faster Delivery**: Accelerated decision-making through proven patterns and best practices
- **Quality Improvement**: Alignment with enterprise standards and architectural principles
- **Strategic Alignment**: Ensuring solutions support long-term business objectives
- **Knowledge Transfer**: Enhancing team capabilities through collaborative engagement

[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#31-consultation-model]

### 3.1 Consultation Model

- **Description**: Short-term advisory engagement for specific questions or decisions
- **Duration**: Hours to days
- **Best For**: Quick guidance, technology questions, architecture clarifications
- **Deliverables**: Recommendations, meeting notes, decision documentation
page_texts.22:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#32-embedded-model]

### 3.2 Embedded Model

- **Description**: Architect assigned to work directly with a team for an extended period
- **Duration**: Weeks to months
- **Best For**: Major projects, complex initiatives, strategic programs
- **Deliverables**: Architecture artifacts, design documents, governance support
page_texts.23:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#33-review-model]

### 3.3 Review Model

- **Description**: Formal evaluation of architecture or design artifacts
- **Duration**: Days to weeks
- **Best For**: Architecture governance, quality assurance, compliance validation
- **Deliverables**: Review findings, recommendations, approval documentation
page_texts.24:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#34-self-service-model]

### 3.4 Self-Service Model

- **Description**: Access to documented standards, patterns, and templates
- **Duration**: Ongoing
- **Best For**: Routine decisions, standard implementations, reference needs
- **Deliverables**: Documentation, templates, guidelines
page_texts.26:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#351-product-sales-efforts]

#### 3.5.1 Product Sales Efforts

- **Description**: EA support for product sales pursuits, RFP responses, and client demonstrations
- **Duration**: Days to weeks, aligned with sales cycle
- **Best For**: RFP/RFI responses, client presentations, solution positioning, competitive differentiation
- **Activities**:
    - Technical solution design for proposals
    - Architecture diagrams and documentation for sales collateral
    - Client-facing presentations and demonstrations
    - Technical due diligence support
    - Proof-of-concept planning and architecture
    - Competitive analysis and differentiation guidance
- **Deliverables**: Solution architecture proposals, technical response content, presentation materials, architecture diagrams
page_texts.27:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#352-product-feature-development]

#### 3.5.2 Product Feature Development

- **Description**: Architecture guidance for new feature development within existing products
- **Duration**: Weeks, aligned with product development cycles
- **Best For**: Feature design, technical feasibility, integration planning, roadmap alignment
- **Activities**:
    - Feature architecture design and review
    - Technical feasibility assessments
    - Integration impact analysis
    - Performance and scalability planning
    - Security and compliance alignment
    - Technical debt assessment and remediation planning
- **Deliverables**: Feature architecture documents, technical specifications, ADRs, integration designs
page_texts.28:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#353-new-product-development]

#### 3.5.3 New Product Development

- **Description**: End-to-end architecture support for new product initiatives from concept to launch
- **Duration**: Months, aligned with product development lifecycle
- **Best For**: Greenfield products, platform development, strategic product investments
- **Activities**:
    - Product architecture vision and strategy
    - Technology stack selection and evaluation
    - Reference architecture development
    - Build vs. buy analysis
    - Vendor and platform assessments
    - MVP architecture definition
    - Scalability and growth planning
- **Deliverables**: Product architecture blueprint, technology recommendations, reference architectures, roadmap alignment documentation
page_texts.29:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#354-mo-operations]

#### 3.5.4 M&O Operations

- **Description**: Architecture support for Maintenance & Operations teams managing production systems
- **Duration**: Ongoing relationship with periodic deep engagements
- **Best For**: Operational improvements, incident resolution, system optimization, modernization planning
- **Activities**:
    - Production architecture assessments
    - Performance optimization recommendations
    - Incident root cause analysis support
    - System modernization and technical debt reduction planning
    - Capacity planning and scalability guidance
    - Operational resilience and reliability improvements
    - Runbook and operational documentation review
- **Deliverables**: Architecture assessments, optimization recommendations, modernization roadmaps, RCA support documentation

[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#43-what-to-include-in-your-request]

### 4.3 What to Include in Your Request

When submitting a request, please provide:

- **Project/Initiative Name**: Clear identifier for the work
- **Business Context**: Why this work is being done and business value
- **Scope Description**: What you need help with
- **Timeline**: Key dates and deadlines
- **Current State**: Existing documentation, designs, or context
- **Stakeholders**: Key contacts and decision makers
- **Urgency Level**: Standard, expedited, or emergency

page_texts.49:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#71-before-engaging]

### 7.1 Before Engaging

- **Do Your Research**: Review existing standards and patterns in this repository
- **Gather Context**: Collect relevant documentation and requirements
- **Identify Stakeholders**: Know who needs to be involved in discussions
- **Define Success**: Understand what a successful outcome looks like
- **Check Timing**: Consider project timeline and EA team availability
page_texts.50:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#72-during-engagement]

### 7.2 During Engagement

- **Be Available**: Respond promptly to architect requests for information
- **Share Openly**: Provide full context including constraints and concerns
- **Collaborate Actively**: Participate in design sessions and reviews
- **Escalate Early**: Raise blockers or concerns as soon as they arise
- **Document Decisions**: Capture key decisions using ADR templates
page_texts.51:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#73-after-engagement]

### 7.3 After Engagement

- **Provide Feedback**: Complete the engagement survey honestly
- **Follow Through**: Implement recommendations as agreed
- **Maintain Contact**: Reach out if questions arise during implementation
- **Share Outcomes**: Report on results to help improve future guidance
- **Pay It Forward**: Share knowledge gained with your team

page_texts.64:
[foundation/engaging-ea-team.md#102-domain-architects]

### 10.2 Domain Architects

For domain-specific questions, connect with the appropriate domain architect:

| Domain | Focus Areas |
|--------|-------------|
| Application Architecture | Application design, microservices, UI/UX architecture |
| Information Architecture | Data modeling, analytics, MDM, data governance |
| Technology Architecture | Cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering |
| Security Architecture | Security controls, compliance, identity management |
| Integration Architecture | APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture |
| Business Architecture | Capabilities, processes, business modeling |
page_texts.65:

### 10.3 Office Hours

The EA team holds regular office hours for drop-in consultations:

- **When**: Every Wednesday, 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM ET
- **Where**: Teams meeting link (posted in EA Teams channel)
- **Format**: Open Q&A, first-come-first-served
- **Best For**: Quick questions, informal guidance, relationship building
